title: Step 2 - Data Preprocessing Techniques: From Raw Data to ML-Ready Datasets

cues.en: Lecturer: So there you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: That's the whole implementation.
cues.zh: 這就是完整的實作。

cues.en: Let me scroll down a bit, and as you can see, you will get many tools.
cues.zh: 往下捲一點，可以看到有很多工具。

cues.en: So let's have a look at them one by one through the table of contents.
cues.zh: 我們依照目錄，一個一個來看。

cues.en: So the first thing I'll teach you is how to import the libraries.
cues.zh: 首先，我會教你匯入函式庫。

cues.en: These are the libraries we will always use in any machine learning model implementation.
cues.zh: 這些是在各種機器學習模型實作中，都會用到的函式庫。

cues.en: So we will include them in the template so that they can be ready to use for our implementations.
cues.zh: 所以會把它們放進模板，方便之後直接使用。

cues.en: Then I will teach you how to import the dataset.
cues.zh: 接著，教你如何匯入資料集。

cues.en: That exact same dataset, which I just introduced to you a few seconds ago, that dataset.
cues.zh: 就是剛才幾秒前介紹過的這一份資料集。

cues.en: I will show you how to first upload it on Google Colab and then import it in your Python file, all right?
cues.zh: 我會示範先上傳到 Google Colab，再讀入 Python 檔案。

cues.en: So that's the second step, importing the dataset.
cues.zh: 這就是第二步：匯入資料集。

cues.en: Then I will teach you how to take care of missing data, because indeed, in most of the datasets you'll work with in your machine learning career, you might encounter some missing data.
cues.zh: 接著會教你處理遺漏資料，因為在機器學習工作中使用的大多數資料集，都可能遇到遺漏值。

cues.en: And that's the case here for our dataset.
cues.zh: 我們這份資料集也是如此。

cues.en: As you can see, there is a missing salary here and a missing age, and I will teach you exactly what to do in order to handle this.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡缺少一個薪資值，這裡缺少一個年齡值，我會教你該如何處理。

cues.en: There are some techniques which are the most relevant to then optimize the training of your machine learning models, and I will show you the best of these techniques.
cues.zh: 有些方法更適合後續機器學習模型的訓練，我會示範其中最實用的技術。

cues.en: All right, then after taking care of the missing data, I will teach you how to encode categorical data, whether it is the independent variable, which is your predictors, or the dependent variable
cues.zh: 處理好遺漏資料後，再教你編碼類別資料，不論是作為預測依據的自變數，

cues.en: which is what you want to predict.
cues.zh: 或是想預測的依變數。

cues.en: So as you can see in our dataset, well, we have actually two categorical variables.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這份資料集其實有兩個類別變數。

cues.en: We have this one, the country column containing indeed three categories, France, Spain, and Germany, as opposed to all these numerical values in the other variables.
cues.zh: 一個是 Country 欄位，包含 France、Spain、Germany 三個類別，和其他變數中的數值資料不同。

cues.en: And also we have this categorical variable containing two categories, Yes and No.
cues.zh: 另一個類別變數則有 Yes 與 No 兩種。

cues.en: All right, so I will teach you what to do with that situation so that then you can be ready to preprocess any data.
cues.zh: 我會教你如何處理，讓你準備好面對各種資料。

cues.en: After this, I will teach you how to split the dataset into the training set and a test set.
cues.zh: 之後會教你把資料集拆成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And that step is very important because each time you wanna train a machinery model, well you have to create two separate sets.
cues.zh: 這一步很重要，因為每次訓練機器學習模型，都要建立兩份獨立資料。

cues.en: One training set where you're going to train your machinery model to understand the correlations inside your dataset, and one test set that you're gonna use to evaluate your machinery models.
cues.zh: 一份訓練集，讓模型學習資料內的關係；另一份測試集，用來評估模型。

cues.en: And that therefore on new observations because the test set is like new data on which the model wasn't trained.
cues.zh: 也就是用新的觀測值來評估，因為模型沒有在測試集上訓練過。

cues.en: So that's very important to do this in order to check that indeed there is not overfitting when your machine learning model is trained too well on the training set,
cues.zh: 這樣才能檢查是否發生過度擬合：模型在訓練集上學得太好，

cues.en: so well that it doesn't perform well on new observations.
cues.zh: 好到無法在新觀測值上表現良好。

cues.en: And so that's why this step is very important and we will include it in the data preprocessing template.
cues.zh: 所以這個步驟非常重要，也會放進資料前處理模板。

cues.en: And finally, I will teach you a very important tool that you might have to use in some of your machine learning model implementations Which is feature scaling, which actually scales
cues.zh: 最後，我會介紹一個在某些模型實作中可能需要的重要工具，也就是特徵縮放，

cues.en: all your features to make sure they are on the right scale.
cues.zh: 把所有特徵調整到適當尺度。

cues.en: So you won't have to use that all the time.
cues.zh: 但不一定每次都要使用。

cues.en: We will see, of course, in each of the machine learning model implementation, whether we have to apply feature scaling or not.
cues.zh: 每一種模型的實作中，都會說明是否需要特徵縮放。

cues.en: So you'll have everything, but we have to include this feature scaling tool in the data preprocessing toolkit because indeed we'll have to use it from time to time.
cues.zh: 因此你都會學到，不過仍要把它納入前處理工具箱，因為有些情況確實會用到。

cues.en: All right, that's the table of contents and we are going to re-implement all this from scratch.
cues.zh: 這就是目錄內容，接下來我們會全部從頭實作。

cues.en: However, if you feel you're comfortable with all these tools and you understand them already and you can't wait to move on to the machine learning implementations,
cues.zh: 如果你已經熟悉這些工具，而且了解它們，迫不及待想開始模型實作，

cues.en: well, feel free to just read this code and make sure you understand it a hundred percent and then move onto part two, regression, where we're gonna build our first regression models.
cues.zh: 可以先讀這些程式，確認百分之百理解後，就進入第二部分迴歸，建立第一批迴歸模型。

cues.en: However, I really insist that this course must be action-based so I really want you to take action as much as you can.
cues.zh: 不過我還是強調，這門課必須以實作為主，希望你盡可能親自動手。

cues.en: And that's why if you're ready to do this for data preprocessing, well, stay with me in this part one because we are going to re-implement each and every single one of these tools.
cues.zh: 所以，如果願意一起做資料前處理，請繼續留在第一部分，我們會逐一重新實作每項工具。

cues.zh: 這就是整個實作的結構。

cues.en: These are all the tools that you will probably need when preprocessing your future dataset for your future machine learning models.
cues.zh: 這些都是未來替機器學習模型準備資料時，可能會需要的工具。

cues.zh: 因此，務必要充分理解這份實作。
